edits.new: For each enumerated subject, identify broader subjects by comparing their `subject` headings: every post about the child subject must also be about the parent. Use these relationships to build the hierarchy upward, combining shared headings. Retain every enumerated subject as an entry, including it in each branch where this relationship holds. Give every heading and subheading its own entry.
edits.old: For each enumerated subject, identify the broader subjects it represents in the post. Use these relationships to build the hierarchy upward, combining shared headings. Retain every enumerated subject as an entry, including it in each branch whose broader subject it refines. Give every heading and subheading its own entry.
